# FeHelper (Front-end Assistant) - Chrome Browser Extension

# Collection of Web Front-end Tools

## Table of Contents
- [Introduction](#introduction)
- [Features](#features)
- [License](#license)
- [Access Rules](#access-rules)

## Introduction

FeHelper (Front-end Assistant) is a Chrome browser extension that includes a collection of small tools frequently used in front-end development. It aims to help front-end developers improve work efficiency.

## Features

FeHelper provides numerous practical tools, including but not limited to:
- [JSON Formatting Tool](/docs/json-format.md) - JSON data beautification, formatting, compression, escaping, etc.
- [Code Beautification Tool](/docs/code-beautify.md) - Beautify HTML, CSS, JS, and other code
- [Code Compression Tool](/docs/code-compress.md) - Compress HTML, CSS, JS, and other code
- [QR Code Generator](/docs/qr-code.md) - Convert text or URLs to QR codes
- [Page Performance Detection](/docs/page-timing.md) - Analyze webpage loading performance
- [Web Screenshot Tool](/docs/screenshot.md) - Web page scrolling screenshots
- [String Encoding/Decoding](/docs/en-decode.md) - Various encoding/decoding tools
- [Regular Expression Test](/docs/regexp.md) - Online regular expression testing
- [Time Conversion Tool](/docs/timestamp.md) - Mutual conversion between timestamps and dates
- [Image Base64 Encoding](/docs/image-base64.md) - Mutual conversion between images and Base64 encoding
- [JSON Comparison Tool](/docs/json-diff.md) - Compare differences between two JSON data
- [Color Picker](/docs/color-picker.md) - Pick colors from web pages
- [Postman API Debugging](/docs/postman.md) - API debugging tool
- [WebSocket Debugging](/docs/websocket.md) - WebSocket connection testing tool
- [Sticky Notes](/docs/sticky-notes.md) - Simple note-taking tool
- [Grid Ruler](/docs/grid-ruler.md) - Page dimension measurement tool
- [SVG Converter](/docs/svg-converter.md) - Conversion between SVG and other formats
- [Excel to JSON](/docs/excel2json.md) - Excel file and JSON data conversion
- [HTML to Markdown](/docs/html2markdown.md) - HTML code to Markdown format
- [Color Value Converter](/docs/trans-color.md) - Conversion between different color representations
- [Base Converter](/docs/trans-radix.md) - Number base conversion
- [Password Generator](/docs/password.md) - Random password generation tool
- [Crontab Parser](/docs/crontab.md) - Cron expression parsing and testing
- [Mind Map](/docs/naotu.md) - Online mind mapping tool
- [Poster Maker](/docs/poster-maker.md) - Simple poster creation tool
- [Chart Maker](/docs/chart-maker.md) - Data visualization chart creation
- [Loan Calculator](/docs/loan-rate.md) - Loan interest rate and repayment calculation
- [Page Customization](/docs/page-monkey.md) - Custom webpage styles and features
- [Developer Tools](/docs/devtools.md) - Web page debugging and inspection tools
- [AI Assistant](/docs/aiagent.md) - Intelligent AI assistant feature
